_comment: Template ONLY. Copy to configs/api_keys.local.json on your phone and fill in real values. NEVER commit real keys to a public repository. Real keys live only in the local (gitignored) file.

groq._note: Enable only if you later decide to use cloud LLM APIs. The assistant works fully without any LLM API: learning happens through installed apps (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Chrome, YouTube, Grok etc.) via accessibility.

siliconflow._note: Same rule: disabled by default, zero-API design comes first.
